scenario: A marketplace accounts-payable team runs automated 3-way matching: supplier invoices are parsed with an OCR extraction tool, the extracted amounts are compared against purchase orders and goods-receipt quantities using a financial calculator, and a match/exception report is generated to approve or hold payment to the supplier.
info_flow: upinvoice extracts structured invoice data (supplier, line items, totals) from a PDF → financial-calculator compares invoice total against PO amount and goods-receipt quantity to compute match variance and determine approval status → reporting generates a 3-way match report recording the payment decision.
